headline: Management consistently guided for mid-to-high single digit volume growth and steady 18-20% margins, mostly delivering on targets.

promises.promise: mid-single-digit value growth for the full year
promises.quote: We are looking at mid-single-digit value growth for the full year.
promises.evidence: Sales grew by 4.9% in FY26, meeting the mid-single-digit value growth target.

promises.promise: gap between volume and value will remain in 4-5% zone
promises.quote: And therefore, we would anticipate that the gap between the volume and the value would remain in that zone of about 4-5%.
promises.evidence: In Q3 FY26, volume was 7.9% and value was 2.8%, resulting in a 5.1% gap.

promises.quote: Given all this, it is okay to maintain the whole guidance of 18 to 20% PBDIT margin band.
promises.evidence: Operating margin for FY26 quarters stayed within the 17-20% band.

promises.promise: train almost 10 lakh people this year
promises.quote: This year, as we kind of go ahead, we are gunning for training almost 10 lakh people.
promises.evidence: No subsequent data was provided to evaluate the training number.

promises.promise: volume growth in 8 to 10 percent band for Q4
promises.quote: I think as we go ahead, this band would remain, in terms of what we would be able to target for the Q4 as well.
promises.evidence: Decorative volume growth achieved 12.4% and coatings volume reached 12.7% in Q4.

promises.promise: high single-digit volume growth of 8-10% in FY27
promises.quote: We are still confident that demand conditions should continue giving us closer to high single-digit volume growth in the band of about 8 -10%, as we predict going forward.
promises.evidence: Q1 FY27 overall volume growth was strong at about 9%.

promises.promise: commission first phase of VAM-VAE in H1 FY27
promises.quote: we expect to commission first phase in the first half of this year.
promises.evidence: No final confirmation of VAM-VAE commissioning was reported in Q1 FY27.

shifts.change: Management narrowed the expected volume-value gap target from 4-5% down to 3-4%.
